title: Project Manager
summary: Manage electrical (LV, MV and HV) and mechanical piping/HVAC construction projects from concept to completion, acting as the primary client contact.
description: Manage electrical (LV, MV and HV) and mechanical piping/HVAC construction projects from concept to completion, acting as the primary client contact.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Lead estimating-to-construction handover and coordinate staffing with the Regional Director.
Validate scope; develop business plans, cost controls, cashflow projections and billing schedules.
Prepare procurement, design and construction programmes, S-curves and histograms; mobilise site, labour and subcontractors.
Manage daily site operations, safety, quality, subcontractor training and weekly progress meetings.
Work with the Quantity Surveyor on costs and sales; monitor productivity, client meetings and monthly reporting.
Oversee testing, commissioning, final audits, life-system certification, O&M manuals and record drawings.
Agree final accounts, demobilise, archive records, submit close-out report and maintain warranty-period contact.
Keep daily site logs, attend management meetings and uphold information security.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: 3+ years in a Project Manager role in the M&E industry.
Track record across multiple projects and full project lifecycle.
Knowledge of building methods, regulations, budget monitoring and control.
Excellent Microsoft Office skills; unrestricted right to work in EU without sponsorship.

sections.heading: Key Competencies & Desirable Attributes
items: Accuracy, commercial awareness, problem-solving, leadership and communication.
